entities.name: Tafre
entities.description: Scarred adventurer, trapfinder and storyteller on Zendikar stationed at Fort Keff.

entities.name: Fort Keff
entities.description: Encampment in a ravine in Akoum.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker who rested at Fort Keff for a night.

entities.name: Bala Gedi surrakar
entities.description: Strange creature caged at the camp, intelligent and capable of speech.

events.summary: Gideon stopped at Fort Keff to rest and Tafre told him of his hand scar and of waking in a field of flesh.
events.quote: the world had gone black, and he had awoken in a field of flesh

events.summary: A strange creature wandered into camp and was caged; Gideon noticed it could speak.
events.quote: a strange creature wandered into the camp and was put into a cage

relations.quote: Tafre was stationed at Fort Keff
